architecture: Causal fixed-heading bank; each block is predicted before its observations enter any particle fit
weak_windows: Defer and return applied delta zero; cold two-second windows cannot switch under the three-block rule
precision: Heading grid separates large basins; the shared InEKF retains local precision after an accepted correction
data_dependencies: No truth, future raw radio, radio-only full-window path, flight direction, or test outcome enters prefix fits or decisions
read_only_shared_replay: differential unified UTIL schedule and InEKF; bank returns only yaw decision plus serializable diagnostics
scoring: Development trial3 and fixed held-out trial4/5, constellations1-4, TDoA2/3; shared nominal and +/-90/180 injected-error schedule
tuning: No thresholds selected using evaluation truth; failures and rejected candidates remain reported
